title: idiotic entities
description: My friend and I put together this texture pack using the combined forces of our sleep deprived minds. Multiple mobs and one item has been re-textured. Enjoy!
body:
My friend and I decided to spice up some of Minecraft's entity and item textures. In this texture pack, you will find some interesting tweaks that came from our sleep deprived, silly, and artistic brains. 

Latest version (v1.1) includes:
- rolled armadillos are a dice
- both pink and baby pink axolotls are now derpier than before
  - this also includes the axolotl bucket
- red push pin tadpole
- blue pufferfish with pink fins
  - pufferfish entity, item, spawn egg, and bucket all have been changed
    - pufferfish bucket and spawn egg has green water... for some reason
- happy creaking
- eyeball shulker
- silly magma cube
- babyfied adult temperate chicken
